title: 有毒排放与废弃物
summary: 评估公司有毒物质排放与废弃物管理绩效，包括减排计划与有害废弃物强度。

sections.title_en: Introduction
sections.title_cn: 引言

blocks.content: This document provides essential information on the components of the Toxic Emissions & Waste Key Issue to enable users of ESG Ratings to understand how MSCI Sustainability & Climate’s (MSCI S&C’s)1 outputs are determined. Toxic Emissions & Waste is a Key Issue in the Environmental Pillar of the MSCI ESG Ratings model. Companies are evaluated on the potential environmental contamination and toxic or carcinogenic emissions arising from their operations and the strength of their environmental management systems.
blocks.content_cn: 本文件介绍有毒排放与废弃物关键议题各组成部分的核心信息，帮助 ESG 评级使用者理解 MSCI 可持续发展与气候团队（MSCI S&C）¹ 如何形成评估结果。有毒排放与废弃物属于 MSCI ESG 评级模型环境支柱下的关键议题。公司评估涵盖运营可能产生的环境污染、有毒或致癌物质排放，以及环境管理体系的健全程度。

blocks.content: For additional details on the MSCI ESG Ratings Model, refer to the Data, ratings and scores section of “ESG Ratings Methodology.”
blocks.content_cn: 关于MSCI ESG评级模型的更多细节，请参阅《ESG评级方法论》中"数据、评级和分数"部分。

sections.title_en: Risks associated with this Key Issue
sections.title_cn: 与本关键议题相关的风险

blocks.content: • Increased costs from liabilities associated with damaging health, property.
blocks.content_cn: • 因损害健康或财产而承担责任，导致成本上升。

blocks.content: • Loss of access to markets through community opposition, heightened regulatory hurdles.
blocks.content_cn: • 因社区反对及监管门槛提高而丧失市场准入。

blocks.content: • Increased costs to meet compliance standards and install equipment and systems to contain pollution.
blocks.content_cn: • 为满足合规标准并安装控制污染的设备和系统而增加成本。

sections.title_en: Toxic Emissions & Waste Key Issue score
sections.title_cn: 有毒排放与废弃物关键议题得分

blocks.content: The Toxic Emissions & Waste Key Issue score evaluates the company’s level of exposure to, and management of, risks on this Key Issue. The Key Issue score is based on the Exposure score and the Management score using the formula below. The Exposure score and the Management score are combined such that a higher level of exposure requires a higher level of demonstrated management capability in order to achieve the same overall Key Issue score.

sections.title_cn: 有毒排放与废弃物管理框架

MSCI S&C assigns each indicator a default weight. Indicator weights may be adjusted at the company level to reflect the relevance of the indicator to the company’s business activities. If a company has no exposure to the business activities covered by an indicator, the indicator is assigned a weight of zero.

sections.title_en: Toxic Emissions & Waste Management score
sections.title_cn: 有毒排放与废弃物管理得分

blocks.content: The Toxic Emissions & Waste Management score evaluates the company’s ability to manage its exposure to risks on this Key Issue. It is based on weighted average of the score associated with each relevant indicator, modified by controversies.
blocks.content_cn: 有毒排放与废弃物管理得分评估公司管理该议题风险敞口的能力。它基于各相关指标得分的加权平均值计算，并根据争议事件进行调整。

blocks.content: This score is derived from indicators that are scored on a 0-10 scale, with 10 corresponding to best practice. Refer to the Analyzing risk management section of “ESG Ratings Methodology” for additional details. Sources are company disclosures except where otherwise indicated.
blocks.content_cn: 该得分来源于按0-10分制评分的指标，10分对应最佳实践。更多细节请参阅《ESG评级方法论》中"风险管理分析"部分。除特别注明外，数据来源为公司披露。

sections.title_en: Toxic Emissions & Waste Governance and Strategy score
sections.title_cn: 有毒排放与废弃物治理与战略得分

blocks.content: The Toxic Emissions & Waste Governance and Strategy score evaluates the company’s initiatives to govern and manage toxic emissions and waste through policies, environmental management systems, certifications, audits, and supply chain programs. Highest initiatives reflect comprehensive policies, certified systems, and proactive oversight across operations and suppliers. It is expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong initiatives.
blocks.content_cn: 有毒排放与废弃物治理与战略得分评估公司通过政策、环境管理体系、认证、审计和供应链计划治理及管理有毒排放与废弃物的举措。最高水平的举措体现为全面的政策、经认证的体系，以及对运营与供应商的主动监督。该得分采用 0—10 分制，10 分表示相关举措有力。

sections.title_en: • Scope and frequency of environmental impact audits
sections.title_cn: • 环境影响审计的范围与频率

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses whether the company conducts regular audits to assess and manage environmental risks and impacts. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating strong initiatives.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估公司是否定期开展审计，以评估和管理环境风险与影响。以 0—10 分表示，10 分代表相关举措有力。

sections.title_en: o Evidence of environmental impact audits
sections.title_cn: ◦ 开展环境影响审计的证据

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether there is evidence that the company conducts internal and/or external environmental audits of its relevant operations. This could include, for example, an EMS certified to ISO 14001 or a similar framework, which requires regular audits.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明是否有证据证明公司对相关运营开展内部和／或外部环境审计。例如，依据 ISO 14001 或类似框架认证的环境管理体系要求定期审计。

sections.title_en: ◦ Evidence of audits across all locations of operations
sections.title_cn: ◦ 审计覆盖全部运营地点的证据

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether there is evidence of environmental audits across all locations of operations.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明是否有证据证明环境审计覆盖全部运营地点。

sections.title_en: ◦ Evidence of annual environmental impact audits
sections.title_cn: ◦ 每年开展环境影响审计的证据

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether there is evidence that the company carries out annual environmental impact audits.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明是否有证据证明公司每年开展环境影响审计。

sections.title_en: • Existence of environmental management system
sections.title_cn: • 是否建立环境管理体系

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether there is evidence that the company has an Environmental Management System (EMS) in place across all or selected relevant operations. This could include, for example, an EMS certified to ISO 14001, registration under EMAS, or a similar framework.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明是否有证据证明公司在全部或选定的相关运营中建立了环境管理体系，例如取得 ISO 14001 认证、在生态管理与审计体系（EMAS）下注册，或采用类似框架。

sections.title_en: • Extent of programs to reduce toxic emissions of supply chain
sections.title_cn: • 减少供应链有毒排放计划的覆盖程度

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates the extent to which the company has established programs to reduce toxic emissions within its supply chain. Best practice is for suppliers’ environmental management to be subject to screening and audits.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司建立供应链有毒排放削减计划的程度。最佳实践是对供应商环境管理进行筛查和审计。

sections.title_en: • Scope of policies to address environmental impacts
sections.title_cn: • 应对环境影响的政策覆盖范围

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company has formal policies in place to address environmental impacts such as air emissions, water discharges, and waste.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司是否建立正式政策，以应对大气排放、水体排放和废弃物等环境影响。

sections.title_en: • Certified environmental system score
sections.title_cn: • 经认证环境体系得分

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses the extent of the company's sites with an environmental management system certified to ISO 14001 or similar. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating the highest degree of certification.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估公司场所环境管理体系获得 ISO 14001 或类似认证的覆盖程度。以 0—10 分表示，10 分代表最高认证程度。

sections.title_en: ◦ Percentage of operations with an environmental management system certified to ISO 14001 or HAZWOPER
sections.title_cn: ◦ 环境管理体系取得 ISO 14001 或危险废弃物作业与应急响应（HAZWOPER）认证的运营比例

blocks.content: Definition: The percentage of sites with hazardous waste guidance that follow ISO 14001 or HAZWOPER certification for waste management.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：具有危险废弃物管理指引且遵循 ISO 14001 或危险废弃物作业与应急响应（HAZWOPER）废弃物管理认证要求的场所比例。

sections.title_en: Toxic Emissions & Waste Targets score
sections.title_cn: 有毒排放与废弃物目标得分

blocks.content: The Toxic Emissions & Waste Targets score evaluates the company’s initiatives to set and achieve targets for reducing toxic emissions and waste. Highest initiatives reflect comprehensive, quantitative reduction targets with demonstrated progress toward achievement. It is expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong initiatives.
blocks.content_cn: 有毒排放与废弃物目标得分评估公司制定及实现有毒排放与废弃物削减目标的举措。最高水平的举措体现为全面、量化的削减目标，以及有证据支持的实现进展。该得分采用 0—10 分制，10 分表示相关举措有力。

sections.title_en: • Toxic emissions & waste target comprehensiveness
sections.title_cn: • 有毒排放与废弃物目标全面性

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses the extent to which a company has established toxic waste reduction targets that have a measurable reduction scope and are complete in coverage. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating a quantitative target that covers all segments.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估公司制定有毒废弃物削减目标的程度，要求削减范围可衡量且覆盖完整。以 0—10 分表示，10 分代表量化目标覆盖所有分部。

sections.title_en: ◦ Evidence of ongoing Toxic Emissions & Waste target
sections.title_cn: ◦ 存在进行中的有毒排放与废弃物目标的证据

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company has an ongoing toxic emissions and/or waste reduction target.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司是否有正在执行的有毒排放和／或废弃物削减目标。

sections.title_en: ◦ Scope of ongoing Toxic Emissions & Waste target
sections.title_cn: ◦ 进行中的有毒排放与废弃物目标范围

blocks.content: Definition: Assess the scope of coverage of the ongoing toxic emissions and/or waste target. Expressed as a 0-10 score, where 10 indicates that the target covers all relevant segments of the company's operations.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估正在执行的有毒排放和／或废弃物目标的覆盖范围。以 0—10 分表示，10 分代表目标覆盖公司运营的所有相关分部。

sections.title_en: • Toxic emissions & waste target progress
sections.title_cn: • 有毒排放与废弃物目标进展

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses the company’s to-date progress on active toxic emissions & waste targets, as well as its historical track record in meeting previously stated targets. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating achievement of stated target.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估公司现行有毒排放与废弃物目标截至目前的进展，以及过往实现已公布目标的记录。以 0—10 分表示，10 分代表已实现公布目标。

sections.title_en: ◦ Status of ongoing Toxic Emissions & Waste target
sections.title_cn: ◦ 进行中的有毒排放与废弃物目标状态

blocks.content: Definition: Measures the current implementation status of the company’s ongoing target on toxic emissions and/or waste management, by assessing the current progress against the target.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：通过评估相对于目标的当前进展，衡量公司正在执行的有毒排放和／或废弃物管理目标的当前实施状态。

sections.title_en: ◦ Status of historical Toxic Emissions & Waste target
sections.title_cn: ◦ 过往有毒排放与废弃物目标状态

blocks.content: Definition: Measures the achievement or completion status of the company’s historical target on toxic emissions and/or waste management, by assessing whether the stated target was achieved or not.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：通过评估公布目标是否实现，衡量公司历史有毒排放和／或废弃物管理目标的实现或完成状态。

sections.title_en: Toxic Emissions & Waste Performance score
sections.title_cn: 有毒排放与废弃物绩效得分

blocks.content: The Toxic Emissions & Waste Performance score evaluates the company's performance on toxic emissions and waste metrics (including NOx emissions, SOx emissions, particulate matter emissions, hazardous and non-hazardous waste, and other relevant pollutants), relative to its peers. It is expressed as a 0-10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
blocks.content_cn: 有毒排放与废弃物绩效得分评估公司相关指标相对于同行的表现，包括氮氧化物排放、硫氧化物排放、颗粒物排放、危险与无害废弃物，以及其他相关污染物。该得分采用 0—10 分制，10 分表示表现强劲。

sections.title_en: • NOx emissions performance relative to peers

blocks.content: The Toxic Emissions & Waste Business Segment Exposure score of a business segment is based on a mapping of the business segment as disclosed by the company to a corresponding business activity. MSCI S&C uses the Standard Industrial Classification (SIC) system along with industry-specific adjustments to define business activities. The score associated with a business activity is used to calculate a Business Segment Exposure score. Each business activity score is determined by a simple average of the Toxicity score, Air Pollutant score, Hazardous Waste score and Radioactivity score of the business activity:

blocks.content: The Toxicity score of a business activity is assessed by examining the toxicity and carcinogenicity (oral and inhalation) risk associated with toxic emissions.
blocks.content_cn: 业务活动的毒性得分通过考察有毒排放相关的毒性和致癌性风险（经口摄入及吸入）进行评估。

blocks.content: The Air Pollutant score of a business activity is assessed by taking a simple average of emissions of carbon monoxide (CO), volatile organic compounds (VOCs), nitrogen oxides (NOx), sulphur oxides (SOx) and particulate matter of 10 micrometer diameter (PM10).
blocks.content_cn: 业务活动的大气污染物得分通过对一氧化碳、挥发性有机物、氮氧化物、硫氧化物以及直径为 10 微米的颗粒物（PM10）的排放量取简单平均值进行评估。

blocks.content: The Hazardous Waste score of a business activity is assessed by examining tons of hazardous waste produced per facility.
blocks.content_cn: 业务活动的危险废弃物得分通过考察每个设施产生的危险废弃物吨数进行评估。

blocks.content: The Radioactivity score of a business activity is assessed through a qualitative assessment of the mining industry. Mining activities related to highly radioactive ores receive a score of 10.
blocks.content_cn: 业务活动的放射性得分通过对采矿业进行定性评估确定。涉及高放射性矿石的采矿活动得 10 分。

sections.title_en: Data sources
sections.title_cn: 数据来源

blocks.content: The following sources are used to determine the Toxic Emissions & Waste Exposure score:
blocks.content_cn: 确定有毒排放与废弃物风险敞口得分时使用以下来源：

blocks.content: The EPA’s Toxics Release Inventory, National Emissions Inventory, and Risk-Screening Environmental Indicators; U.S. Economic Census; Refinitiv; MSCI S&C; company disclosures.
blocks.content_cn: 美国环境保护署有毒物质排放清单、国家排放清单和风险筛查环境指标；美国经济普查；路孚特；MSCI 可持续发展与气候团队；公司披露。
